worldcombat.skill.skyattack.summary: Charge in place for a full beat (interruptible), then soar above the drop point and plunge straight down as a heavy blow; the drop point is fixed at take-off and never homes in, so a target that moves during the plunge is missed. A hit may flinch and interrupt it. High Dive braces longer but hits harder.
It plunges straight down from above, dealing about %1$s damage on a hit; charge altitude is %2$s blocks and descent speed %3$s blocks/tick. The drop point is fixed at take-off and never tracks, so a target that moves during the plunge is missed.
Charging takes %1$s while standing still, with an impact radius of %2$s blocks; the charge can be interrupted, and an interrupted cast spends no PP - this move's open flaw.
On a hit there is a %1$s chance to flinch the target for %2$s, interrupting its interruptible action and preventing new moves and ordinary attacks during that time.

worldcombat.skill.skyattack.preference.h: On: altitude x1.3 and plunge power x1.12, at +6 tick charge, +3 tick recovery and +12 tick cooldown - a longer opening for a heavier blow. Off (Low Dive): a faster, safer windup with altitude and power a notch lower.
worldcombat.skill.skyattack.preference.a: It only considers taking off within this distance; smaller keeps it close, larger lets it open from farther away.
When on, an airborne target ranks higher - the drop point sits right on it and it is harder to slip away during the charge; when off all targets rank alike.
